topics.definition: Transformers are deep learning models designed to process sequences efficiently using self-attention.
tips: Transformers are the foundation of modern generative AI.

topics.definition: Attention helps a model focus on the most relevant parts of the input.
AI agents perceive their environment, make decisions and perform actions to achieve goals.
tips: Agents may use tools and memory.

topics.definition: RAG combines information retrieval with language models to generate more accurate responses.
tips: Reduces hallucinations by using external knowledge.

topics.definition: Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to a specific task or dataset.
Quantization reduces model size and improves inference speed by using lower-precision numbers.
Responsible AI focuses on fairness, privacy, transparency, safety and accountability.
tips: Protect user data and evaluate bias.

topics.definition: AI is expected to advance in automation, healthcare, education, robotics and scientific research.
tips: Continue learning as the field evolves rapidly.

topics.definition: Build AI systems that are accurate, secure, explainable and continuously monitored.
tips: Validate outputs and monitor real-world performance.
